component.name: Kanji Trainer
component.summary: Practice JLPT vocabulary written in kanji

description.p: Kanji Trainer drills JLPT words: how they are written, how they sound and what they mean. Build a run by hand from topic sets and single words, answer by multiple choice or typing, from kanji, kana, pictures and recordings, and review your score reports to see which kanji and which formats need more work.
